response.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_pressratio), AVG(avg_size_per_minute) FROM (SELECT s.zoneref, si.typesite, AVG(s.pressratio) as avg_pressratio, AVG(s.gbsize / s.spanmin) as avg_size_per_minute FROM scans s INNER JOIN sites si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry WHERE s.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND s.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.typesite) subquery
